column4: The ice sheet-shelf model of ref. 51 (Pollard and DeConto 2012, PSU3D-ICE) with "Several advances relative to previous versions": new buttressing, hydrofracturing and ice-cliff calving formulations
column7: "The ice sheet-shelf model uses hybrid ice dynamics" with the "dynamical shallow shelf (SSA) equations"; ref. 51: "a hybrid combination of the scaled shallow ice and shallow shelf approximations"
column8: DC21 Methods (Ice-sheet modelling framework); Pollard and DeConto 2012, GMD 5, 1273
column10: "A resolution of 10 km is used for continental simulations used in our main ensembles (Figs. 1-3). A nested 1-km grid is used for a select simulation over West Antarctica"
column15: The 1-km nest is a single West Antarctic simulation, not part of the Figure 1 ensembles; 10 km is a bin edge and belongs to the lower bin
column18: "initial ice-sheet conditions ... follow the same procedure as in ref. 8 and are identical in all simulations. Initialization involves a 100,000-kyr [sic] spin-up using observed mean annual ocean climatology and standard SeaRISE atmospheric temperature and precipitation fields", with basal sliding coefficients "determined by an inverse method that iteratively matches model ice-surface elevations to observations". "Future ice-sheet simulations begin in 1950"
column19: DC21 Methods (Ensemble scoring based on recent observations; Ice-sheet modelling framework); inverse method of Pollard and DeConto 2012, TC 6, 953
column21: A long spin-up in which basal sliding coefficients are adjusted to nudge the surface elevation toward observations: Hybrid by rule D1 (as DeConto and Pollard 2016, ref. 8)
column22: "The model uses a standard Weertman-type basal sliding law [ref. 51]". Ref. 51 gives ub = C'|τb|^(m-1) τb with "m = 2"; C' ramps from no sliding below a homologous basal temperature of -3 °C to full sliding at the melt point; C(x,y) from the inverse method; no effective-pressure term
column23: DC21 Methods; Pollard and DeConto 2012, GMD 5, 1273, Eqs. 10-11
column28: Cascade step 4: not Coulomb-limited, no effective-pressure dependence, m ≠ 1
column29: Quadratic in the 400-m thermal forcing, one uniform coefficient calibrated on a 625-member deglacial ensemble (DC21 ref. 55)
